resources.string: Criba only counts files. Scanning never deletes: the default mode is read-only.
No files of 100 MB or more
Without media read permission, photos, videos and audio cannot be analysed.
The files could not be analysed. Try again.
Only photos, videos and audio are analysed; documents, zips and APKs are searched in Downloads with the button below.
To see APKs, zips and documents in Downloads, Android requires the «All files access» permission. Criba only uses it to read and never deletes anything.
No files older than 90 days in Downloads
No installed APKs or APKs older than 30 days
Without all files access, Downloads cannot be read. You can grant it in the system settings.
Downloads could not be analysed. Try again.
The screenshots could not be analysed. Try again.

Choose a folder; Criba looks inside it for empty subfolders or subfolders unchanged for more than a year. It only reads and never deletes anything. Android does not allow choosing Downloads or the storage root.
The folder could not be analysed. Try again.
Categories can overlap: the total does not count the same file twice. Empty or unused folders are not included in the total.
Criba only reads: it deletes nothing.
Screenshots are images: they cannot be moved until a verified backup exists.
Moving files to Criba\'s trash requires the «All files access» permission.
Files cannot be moved without this access.
Photo, video or audio: cannot be moved until a verified backup exists.
Protected: Criba will not touch this file.
The selection could not be validated. Review it again.
Files are stored in Criba\'s trash (a hidden folder) and are not permanently deleted. Space is not freed until the trash is emptied.
Files are stored in Criba\'s trash; they have not been permanently deleted.
The move could not be completed: %1$s
a file with this name already exists in trash
file is no longer indexed in trash
